description: The user's days in one read: calendar events, Moments (lived stories) and Food Diary entries for a civil date range in the account timezone (max 92 days; default today). A food entry's calendar mirror is listed once, under food. Text the connection may not see is redacted as in get_events. Each record keeps its id and inspect_url where it has a page. ($0.05; API key required)

at.description: Optional ISO instant to read "today" at (defaults to now).

from.description: First civil day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the account timezone. Alone = that one day. Default: today.

timezone.description: Optional IANA zone of the user's device (e.g. Asia/Singapore). Used only when the account has no zone set; the profile zone wins.

name: get_timeline

items.description: A calendar event, as get_events returns it.
A Food Diary entry, as get_food_log returns it.
A Moment, as get_moments returns it.

truncated.description: true per section when more rows exist than were returned.

title: Get Timeline
